subject: RunTime Summit: short technical case study from NovaPayments?
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Gomez <aisha.gomez@novapay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: RunTime Summit: short technical case study from NovaPayments?

Hi Aisha —

Hope all's well. We're pulling together the final slate for the RunTime Summit (Dec 7–8) and there’s a short technical forum (25 minutes) on \"Productionizing LLMs for Real-time Financial Workflows.\" Given the work NovaPayments did with Redwood on low-latency fraud scoring, I wanted to see if you'd consider a short case-study session — either Evan or you + an engineer for a 15-minute tech talk + 5 minutes for audience Q&A.

Quick details:
- 20–25 minute slot, purely technical (latency tradeoffs, batching, KV cache patterns).
- We handle travel and lodging for the speaker, travel stipend available.
- We’ll promote the talk across our customer channels and include a short case study asset after the event.

Attached is a one-pager with slot info and a proposed outline. If it's of interest, can we pencil in a 20-min planning call next week?

Appreciate it — let me know what would work.

Best,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Marketing, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference

Attachment: run_time_summit_onepager.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
Attachment: proposed-talk-outline.docx (DOCX, 34KB)

From: Aisha Gomez <aisha.gomez@novapay.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evan Lee <evan.lee@novapay.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: RunTime Summit: short technical case study from NovaPayments?

Hi Lauren —

Thanks — this sounds interesting. Evan and I discussed; Evan is out Nov 16–22, but our lead infra engineer, Samir Rao, would be a perfect fit for the technical session. He worked on the batching and quantization changes that brought our p95 latency down 65%.

We’re happy to participate if the format is as you described. Two quick asks:
1) Can you confirm the AV format and whether we can present live code snippets?
2) We prefer to approve any public-facing slides in advance (company policy).

If that works, I'll introduce Samir and we can schedule the planning call for the 15th (we're open 10–11am PT).

Best,
Aisha Gomez
Head of Partnerships, NovaPayments
Aisha.Gomez@novapay.com

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RunTime Summit: short technical case study from NovaPayments?

Samir — great to meet you by email. Thanks, Aisha. We're excited Samir can join.

Quick answers to your questions:
- AV / format: We support slides + 2 live terminals (for short code demos). We’ll provide a cloud-connected laptop at the speaker table; you can also bring your own laptop.
- Slide approvals: Absolutely — we'll send a draft to NovaPayments marketing 72 hours before the talk for sign-off.

Ben — looping you in to coordinate logistics and the speaker agreement. Marissa — can you handle the post-talk case study asset and coordinate a short shoot for a 3-min customer testimonial video?

Samir — can we tentatively schedule the 20-min planning call on Mon, Nov 15 at 10:30am PT? I'll send a calendar invite + agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Lauren

Subject: Re: RunTime Summit: short technical case study from NovaPayments? — logistics + speaker agreement

Hi Aisha / Samir —

Thanks again for agreeing to join. Logistics and next steps:
- Confirmed planning call: Mon Nov 15, 10:30am PT (calendar invite sent).
- Speaker agreement: attached (standard speaker terms; simple IP/recording permission, travel reimbursement). Please return signed copy to me and we'll process the stipend.
- AV: We’ll set you up with two HDMI inputs and a patch laptop; live terminal demos are fine but keep them short (<3 minutes).
- Slides: Please send a draft to marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com by Dec 4 for approval.
- Promo: We’ll run a short pre-event case blurb. Samir, if you have a short one-paragraph blurb about the talk (1–2 sentences), send it to Marissa.

Attachments: speaker_agreement_novapay.pdf (PDF, 12KB)

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
